_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_playable_pay_life_instead.py. t_ppl_raid is Nashi, Moon Sage's Scion's trigger as a sorcery (exile the top card of each player's library, play one of them, spells for life); t_ppl_plain_raid the same play-one permission without the life clause; t_ppl_heist puts the rider on the exile op itself.

cards.name: Test Moon Raid
cards.oracle_text: Exile the top card of each player's library. Until end of turn, you may play one of those cards. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.

cards.name: Test Plain Moon Raid
cards.oracle_text: Exile the top card of each player's library. Until end of turn, you may play one of those cards.

cards.name: Test Life Heist
cards.oracle_text: Exile target card from an opponent's graveyard. You may cast it this turn. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
